description: Arcade lets you build branded product videos and demos directly from ChatGPT, without switching tools or tabs. Give ChatGPT a prompt, screenshots, or notes from a call, and it generates an on-brand video with visuals, animations, and narration. You can also query performance data from your existing Arcades to see which demos are driving engagement. Useful for product marketing, sales follow-ups, product releases, and paid ads. Use together with other Apps such as Figma, Granola, Notion, Slack, and Apollo to automate workflows end to end.

defaultPrompt: create a marketing video showcasing our app
revise the script to use the customer's voice
how is my latest demo performing?
